lines.text: @maya_front walks the length of the waterline at dawn as the light comes up gold behind her, then stops and looks out to sea.

new_beats.text: Some mornings, the sea asks nothing of you.

writes.note: I added a short VO that lets the dawn walk breathe and sits over the shot.

reply.rationale: Kept the shot's words as they were and added one quiet VO line, about 3 s, matching the unhurried direction and the shot's length.
